description: kernel.kptr_restrict written down at 0 and kernel.dmesg_restrict at 1: the two ends of one leak, one closed and one held open in writing. It is the mirror of kernel-leak-dmesg-off and exists because kernel-leak-capsyslog stopped being that mirror at catalog 33, when a configured 1 became a PASS. /proc agrees with the files, so KERNEL-0002 and KERNEL-0018 are looking at the same value and must reach the same verdict about it.
